attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Connecticut state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 7 brackets per CT Department of Revenue Services (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Connecticut Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ct_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CT tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ct_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /ct_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ct_tax xdef
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_1_limit min result.ct_bracket_1_rate mul /ct_tax xdef
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_1_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_2_limit min result.ct_bracket_1_limit sub result.ct_bracket_2_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_2_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_3_limit min result.ct_bracket_2_limit sub result.ct_bracket_3_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_3_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_4_limit min result.ct_bracket_3_limit sub result.ct_bracket_4_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_4_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_5_limit min result.ct_bracket_4_limit sub result.ct_bracket_5_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_5_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit min result.ct_bracket_5_limit sub result.ct_bracket_6_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit sub result.ct_bracket_7_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_tax /result.ct_state_tax xdef ct_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Connecticut tax calculated (Single): $" result.ct_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CT tax for Married Filing Jointly using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ct_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /ct_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ct_tax xdef
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_1_rate mul /ct_tax xdef
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_1_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_2_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_3_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_4_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_3_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_4_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_4_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_5_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_4_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_5_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_5_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit_joint min result.ct_bracket_5_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_6_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit_joint gt { ct_taxable_income result.ct_bracket_6_limit_joint sub result.ct_bracket_7_rate mul ct_tax add /ct_tax xdef } if
ct_tax /result.ct_state_tax xdef ct_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Connecticut tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.ct_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Connecticut military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay, SBP payments, and National Guard/Reserve pay. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per CT Gen. Stat. § 12-701 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Connecticut Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.ct_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.ct_sbp_exclusion xdef 0 /result.ct_guard_reserve_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay, SBP payments, and Guard/Reserve pay
